import os,glob,re,json
def load():

    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

from collections import Counter
import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def diff(n):
    di=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; do_=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    ch=set((i,j) for i in range(len(di)) for j in range(len(di[0])) if di[i][j]!=do_[i][j])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in di for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; mark=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]
    sc=set(c for row in di for c in row if c not in (bg,mark))
    srows={i for i in range(len(di)) for j in range(len(di[0])) if di[i][j] in sc}
    scol={j for i in range(len(di)) for j in range(len(di[0])) if di[i][j] in sc}
    rs=[i for i,j in ch]; cs=[j for i,j in ch]
    print(f'demo{n}: bg={bg} mark={mark} seedcolors={sc} seedrows={sorted(srows)} seedcols={sorted(scol)}')
    print(f'  drawn bbox rows {min(rs)}-{max(rs)} cols {min(cs)}-{max(cs)}')
    # walls = mark cells; distances from seed bbox to nearest wall per direction
    sr0,sr1=min(srows),max(srows); sc0,sc1=min(scol),max(scol)
    def ndir(pos,d):
        s,p=pos[0]+d,pos[1]
        n=0
        while 0<=s<len(di) and di[s][p]!=mark: s+=d
        return n
    dr=ndir((sr0,0),1)-1 if True else ndir((sr0,sc0-1),1)
    print(f'  wall dist: up={ndir((sr1,sc0-1),-1)-0}')
    return di,do_,ch,bg,mark,sc
for n in [1,2,3,4,5,6]:
    di,do_,ch,bg,mark,sc=diff(n)

from collections import Counter
import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for n in range(1,7):
    di=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; do_=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(di),len(di[0])
    ch=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if di[i][j]!=do_[i][j]]
    rs=[i for i,_ in ch]; cs=[j for _,j in ch]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    # nearest wall (mark) cell to the bbox on each side
    def nearest(s,d,sz):
        best=None
        for k in range(1,sz):
            p=s+d*k
            if p>=sz: break
            hit=False
            for q in range(min(0,p), max(0,min(p-1,p+1))): pass
            break
        return None
    # proper: for each side, min distance of any bbox-edge... compute min distance from bbox interior to nearest mark cell outside bbox
    res=[]
    for name,dr,dc in [('top',r0,-1),('bottom',r1,1),('left',c0,-1),('right',c1,1)]:
        d=1
        while True:
            s=r0+dr*d if name!='left' else c0+dc*d
            cells={(s,q) for q in (c0,c1)} if name=='top'else {(q,s) for q in (r0,r1)}
            hhit=any(0<=s<H and 0<=q<W and di[s][q]==Counter(x for row in di for x in row).most_common(2)[1][0] for s,q in cells)
            if hhit: res.append((name,d)); break
            d+=1
    print(f'demo{n}: bbox r{r0}-{r1} c{c0}-{c1}; nearest wall dist outward: {res}')

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for n in (6,7,8):
    i=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; j=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h,w=len(i),len(i[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in i for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    print('pair',n,'bg',bg,'counts',dict(cnt))
    # filled cells: output!=input
    fill={(r,c):(i[r][c],j[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if i[r][c]!=j[r][c]}
    vals=collections.Counter(v for v,_ in fill.values())
    print('  fill values out:',dict(vals))
    kept_in=[v for v,_ in fill.values() if v!=bg]
    print('  pre-existing non-bg under fill:',dict(collections.Counter(kept_in)))

import collections
for n in (6,7,8):
    i=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; j=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h,w=len(i),len(i[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in i for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seeds=[(r,c,i[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if i[r][c]!=bg]
    seedvals=set(s[2] for s in seeds)
    # find seed pair: two cells whose colors are the minority colors
    rare=collections.Counter(s[2] for s in seeds)
    sp=[s for v,c in rare.items() if v not in seedvals or True]
    # identify seed pair as the two cells with distinct non-bg colors appearing few times
    from_col=collections.Counter(s[2] for s in seeds)
    pair=[(s[0],s[1],s[2]) for v,c in from_col.items() if v not in (bg,) and c<=2]
    print('pair',n,'bg',bg,'seed colors counts',dict(from_col),'seed pair',pair)
    F={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if i[r][c]!=j[r][c]}
    # unfilled cells with "checkerboard" potential: colors {a,b}=rare colors assigned by (r+c) parity relative to pair position
    # determine mapping: which color is on which parity
    p={}
    for (rr,cc,sv) in pair:
        for par in ((rr+cc)%2,):
            p[par]=sv
    a=p.get(0); b=p.get(1)
    miss=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if (r,c) not in F:
                pr=(r+c)%2
                exp = a if pr==p[0] else b
                if i[r][c]==bg and exp is not None:
                    miss.append((r,c,exp))
    print('  unfilled bg cells matching parity:',len(miss), 'sample',miss[:10])

import os,re,json,collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

for n in (6,7,8):
    i=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; j=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    h,w=len(i),len(i[0])
    cnt=collections.Counter(x for r in i for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # seed pair: minority non-bg colors
    rare={v:c for v,c in cnt.items() if v!=bg}
    sv=[v for v in rare if rare[v]<=2]
    sp=[(r,c,i[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if i[r][c] in sv]
    assert len(sp)==2, (n, sp)
    a,b=sp[0],sp[1]
    pa=a[0]+a[1]; pb=b[0]+b[1]
    par_col={pa:a[2],pb:b[2]}
    print('pair',n,'seeds',a,b,'parmap',par_col)
    data=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if i[r][c]==bg:
                pr=(r+c)%2
                pred=None
                # parity mapping by absolute parity
                if (r+c)%2==pa%2: pred=par_col[pa]
                elif (r+c)%2==pb%2: pred=par_col[pb]
                # else ambiguous (period 2 -> always one)
                ch=j[r][c]!=i[r][c]
                dist=min(abs(r-sr)+abs(c-sc) for sr,sc,_ in [a,b])
                nwb=sum(1 for dr in(-1,0,1) for dc in(-1,0,1) if 0<=r+dr<h and 0<=c+dc<w and i[r+dr][c+dc]!=bg)
                data.append({'r',c,ch,pred, dist,nwb})
    tab=collections.Counter((d['ch'],d['pred is not None']) for d in data)
    print('  ch/unfilled:',tab)
    # unchanged with correct prediction
    wrong=[d for d in data if d['pred'] and not d['ch'] and d['pred']==j[r][c] ]
    print('  unchanged w correct pred count',sum(1 for d in data if d['pred'] and not d['ch']))
    if wrong[:8]: print('  sample:',[(d['dist'],d['nwb']) for d in wrong[:8]])
